p12: On December 15, 2021, the MTA Board approved a letter amendment (Amendment #1) | p12: This amendment increased the Capital Program by $535 million from $54.799 billion to $55.334 billion, the CPRB portion increased from $51.472 billion to $52.007 billion. | p12: The CPRB approved this amendment on December 23, 2021.
